system.description:
Like a hypnotist, you plant commands in a subject's mind, even keying them to a later trigger. If you can meet the subject's gaze and speak your instructions aloud, you can force obedience now or long after.

Meet the subject's gaze, speak your instructions, and make a Mental Challenge (retest Intimidation). You may impart any command that is not self-destructive, either carried out immediately ("Go fetch me a mortal vessel") or implanted with a trigger event ("When the prince ends court, sneeze loudly"). Only one such command may be held in a victim at a time, and both trigger and suggestion must be clear. Unless further powers are used, the victim may remember the process. Implanting takes only as long as it takes to speak the whole order.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Disciplines
